trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle, creating a sharp division between the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge of the left lobe exhibits a continuous sequence of small-scale, irregular serrations with pixel-level variations in depth along the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading and trailing edges of the visible lobes follow a distinct convex curve that tapers to sharp, acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular clusters and individual nodes are visible along the leading edge of the leftmost lobe and near the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, raised white nodules (consistent with barnacle colonization) are visible along the leading edges of both lobes.
